resources.string: Lets the shortcut keys act on the app in front: reads which activity is open and which buttons it offers.

MiniKeys reads the window that is currently in front to build its shortcut keys: the app and activity that are open, and the actions that screen offers (tap, input, scroll, toggle). No content is stored or sent anywhere; the tree is read while the service is enabled and is used only to run the key you press.
